author: SilverBullet4869
body:
SilverBullet4869 - Staff Application


Age: 15

Timezone: +4 GMT

Do you have Teamspeak? No, but will if I get approved.

Do you have Discord? No, but will if I get approved.

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes

---


CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION 


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers? 

No.


What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating?

Not being active much during school days.


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not?

Passion, Ambition, Quality and a brave personality. Usually no cause I don't fulfil all of the qualities mentioned but, when there is no one leading, I usually step up.


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

Experience & Time at Avicus. I have been at Avicus for nearly 3 years and have seen how the moderators deal with various situations so I am experienced during these situations.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

Social skills & Confidence. Must have confidence to talk & must be capable of interacting.


What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?

Fair, Intelligent & Consistent. They need to be fair in certain situations. For example, 2 players is scamming other users to leave the game, the mod should not warn 1 & kick 1, both need to have the same fair punishment. They need to be smart like to deduct if a player is hacking. Lastly, they need to be consistent in playing Minecraft and doing their job.

---


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS


You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do?

Report it to higher rankings to investigate. I will also record him being careless and explain it to the higher rankings to deal with it.


You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do?

Try and calm the situation down. The situation could get fiery.


You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

Notify them to take it down if I can't take it down.

Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do?

I will tell them that those players don't like these actions and will try to stop them. I will try and convince them to stop and that we should respect every person's rights.

---


CRITERIA 3: OTHER


Why do you want to be a moderator?

I want to help Avicus. Simple as. Quite often, I see hackers with no mods online. Players get extremely frustrated when there are hackers and no mods online and can get out of control. 


What does Avicus mean to you?

A lot. I have been playing on this server since I was 11. The players are always fun to chat with. Server is just great in general.


Anything specific the staff team could do better?

Be more active. Avicus has a lot of staff members yet I sometimes barely see any. Most of the time when players are active only 1 or 2 mods are online.


Why did you choose to apply at Avicus?

It is 1 of 2 servers that enjoy the most playing at. Hypixel is the other. With Hypixel, the job is tough due to the large amount of players. I have no experience of being a mod. Avicus would be a great way of improving a lot of my skills including: Communication, Experience and Dealing with Situations. Another thing is that because I enjoy playing on this server a lot. During a certain period, I would always play on Avicus for 3 hours constant.


Do you have anything else to add to your application

My time zone could be suitable for a mod. However, I will be returning to school very soon, in about 2 weeks time. During school days I don't play a lot of Minecraft as I don't find anything enjoyable when I am at school. This would change if I was a staff member, for the simple reason of that I would have something to care about.


Thank You for reading my Application.
